second_order: building and enlarging la bandera together
theme_note: Participants turn coordinates, dimensions, letters, plans, and choices between manual work and scripts into a flag they can build together; the practice ranges from the first call to maintain it through successive starts and a last small flag.

Participants repeatedly notice damage, recruit more hands or accounts, direct attention to particular pixels, fix both flags, and admit their own mistakes; what varies is whether repair is individual, coordinated, or shared with Puerto Rico.

second_order: running scripts and bots for both flags
theme_note: Participants offer, explain, circulate, test, and run scripts or bots so Dominican and Puerto Rican pixels persist; the practice ranges from instructions and compatibility questions to calls to keep both scripts active.

second_order: standing with and answering the boricuas
theme_note: People ask for help, announce it is coming, thank helpers, stand with the boricuas, and describe the two countries as joined; the practice varies between requests arriving from Puerto Rico and Dominican offers of support.

second_order: putting Dominican and Caribbean signs into the canvas
theme_note: Participants debate the escudito, propose Presidente, mamajuana or plantains, and design PRD, Cuban, Antillean, and DR-PR additions; what varies is whether they defend a national detail or widen the design into Caribbean unity.

second_order: celebrating and claiming the small flags
theme_note: Participants mark progress, identify what they and their siblings made, call the joined flags small but proud, and celebrate barely making it; the claims vary from a tiny heart flag to survival at the end.

second_order: naming who is destroying the flags and why
theme_note: Participants attribute damage to bots, Germans, Dutch or Europeans, invoke conquest and sleep schedules, and explain erasure through programmed attacks; these are their own warnings and explanations, not independently established causes.

second_order: negotiating a new place after the old spot is gone
theme_note: Participants take the lost old spot to r/placeNL's diplomatic thread, coordinate overlapping requests, and weigh a new location against refusing to fold; the practice holds negotiation together while preserving disagreement about relocation.

second_order: answering a pixel mistake with a doubtful screenshot
theme_note: A participant responds to a mistaken repair by linking a screenshot with only 'hmmm'; no other code performs the same practice closely enough to merge it.
